submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a targeted local restoration of an existing Daoist Q-style hand-painted coastal map, not a new scene. Image 1 is the exact 1254 x 1254 native edit target. Return one native 1254 x 1254 PNG with exactly the same framing, scale, camera, palette, rock positions, object identities and registration. Repair the V-shaped clipping/notch in the light foreground rock top near local x490–630,y220–350, and the long angular abrupt color/brushwork seam running down that same rock surface near local x540–685,y870–1100. Make the rounded rock silhouette and its single continuous surface coherent. Preserve the existing shadows between boulders; do not add cracks or change rocks. Change only the described defects inside crop-local rectangle [380, 120, 900, 1139]. Preserve every pixel outside that allowed rectangle as closely as possible, especially the outer 115 pixels on every side. Away from the defects do not repaint, smooth or recolor anything. Preserve fine matte hand-painted gray/slate stone, warm sunlight, sand and existing shadows. Correct the geometry and light continuity at original native detail; no blur, feather haze, resizing, perspective shift, invented content, buildings, UI, lettering or watermark. Fixed unchanged context around the repair is essential for seamless native patch insertion.
